method: Every vehicle sprite in the delivered drop was rendered at 460px with its filename and the heading that filename promises, and read by eye (docs/ASSET_INTEGRATION_REPORT.md §4). The reading is 'where does the nose point on screen' — grille and headlights forward, tail lights back. A supporting measurement (centroid of saturated-red pixels against the subject centroid) agreed on every case it could resolve and is recorded in the report; it is not the evidence, because it cannot separate a front view from a rear view when the sprite is near-axial.
finding: The drop contains only FORWARD-facing views. A vehicle heading away from the camera shows its rear, and the generator produced no rear or rear-three-quarter view for three of the four archetypes — the three 'receding' slots (n, ne, nw) were filled with duplicates of forward views instead. The sedan is the single exception: its `sw` file is a genuine rear-three-quarter heading north-west.
impact: The road runs east-west in world space, and world-west projects to screen `nw`. Half of all road traffic therefore drew a car facing the wrong way — nose pointing down-right while the car moved up-left, which reads as reversing.
resolution: `assets:import` assigns each source file to the facing it actually shows, mirroring where a mirror is truthful. Slots with no truthful source fall back to the nearest available heading, always preserving the left/right sense, and are listed in `gaps` below as art that must be regenerated. Nothing is fabricated and nothing is silently relabelled: this file is the mapping.

sw.note: the `n` file is a front three-quarter heading south-west; the `nw` file is a near-duplicate of it

nw.note: the `sw` file is the set's only rear three-quarter, and it heads north-west

ne.note: mirroring the rear three-quarter swaps north-west for north-east — truthful, because a car is laterally symmetric

n.note: no rear elevation exists; the rear three-quarter is the nearest truthful view, 45 degrees off

s.note: front view; the `n` file is a near-duplicate of it

ne.note: no rear three-quarter exists; the side elevation keeps the left/right sense and loses only the vertical component

n.note: no rear view of any kind exists; a side elevation is 90 degrees off, a front view would be 180

s.note: front view; the `n` file is a near-duplicate of it

n.note: no rear view of any kind exists

s.note: front view; the `n` file is a near-duplicate of it

n.note: no rear view of any kind exists

gaps.note: Ten views that no delivered file can supply truthfully. Each is currently drawn by the nearest available heading, which is visibly approximate but never contradicts the direction of travel. Regenerating these is the one art task this consolidation could not do for itself — an agent cannot generate images.
